points: Hashem tells Yechezkel to stand up: the mission ahead needs strength and courage.
"Ben adam": Rashi reads it as humbling (you are only human); the Radak reads it as uplifting (a human face is on the Merkava).
This mirrors the mussar debate: do we grow by feeling small or by feeling lofty? Different people need different approaches.
He is warned the people are rebellious and his life will be in danger. Don't be afraid; keep going.
He eats the scroll of bitter prophecies: a navi must internalize his message, not just pass it on. In the next perek it tastes sweet.
